messages.author: f97d21be02e5ed9b
messages.subject: Error during compileNimble
parts:
I'm running into an error when I go to compile my model after building the MCMC. 

The error says:
Error: Error, wrong number of indices provided for getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,2)[1].
 This occurred for: getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,2)[1]
 This was part of the call:  model_dist[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,3), getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,2)[1], getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)]

Is this potentially caused because I named a node "dist" and it's conflicting with something internally? Here's the part of the model that uses "dist":

g0 ~ dunif(0,1)
sigma ~ dunif(0, 100)
    for(t in 1:nocc){
      for(k in 1:ntrap){
        for(i in 1:M){
        dist[i,k,t] <- sqrt((s[i,1,t]-trap[k,1])^2 + (s[i,2,t]-trap[k,2])^2) #trap given as data
        p[i,k,t] <- g0*exp(-dist[i,k,t]^2/(2*sigma^2))
        }
        for(i in 1:nind){
      y[i,k,t] ~ dbin(p[i,k,t]*z[i,t], open[k,t]) #open given as data
        }
    }
  }

I'm happy to send the full model off list if that would help, but wanted to make sure it wasn't something glaringly obvious first.

Best,
Heather

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Error during compileNimble
parts:
This error usually means that the number of indices (e.g "dist[i, k, t]" has 3 indices: i, k and t) for some variable is not completely consistent somewhere in the code and/or the constants, inits or data (e.g. if somewhere dist appears with only 2 indices).  The "model_dist" in the error message indicates the problem is detected for the line that begins "dist[i, k, t] <- ". It could arise from any of the variables appearing on that line (including s and trap), not necessarily dist itself. If you double-check all other declarations and any values in constants, inits and data for inconsistencies in the number of indices in dist, s and trap and you can't resolve the problem, then please do send the full model and inputs off-list.
HTH
Perry
